'''Krallo''', known by her nickname '''"The Party"''', was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. She was stationed aboard [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
"The Party" Krallo appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as the Social Items vendor for Imperial players on Vaiken Spacedock.<ref name="TOR" />
